title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases Worksheet: Further Extension Days
content:
**Definitions.** For a further extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case:

- **Measured extension:** the number of calendar days the request's supporting document measures from the current resolution deadline. It is counted below zero when the end it measures to falls before the current resolution deadline.
- **Extension length:** the measured extension with every addition made and every deduction taken.
- **Further extension days:** the extension length raised to 30 calendar days when it is fewer, so that no extension shorter than 30 days is granted, and then limited to the plan's extension days when it is more. Every addition and deduction is made before the extension length is raised or limited. The result is a whole number of calendar days.

**Standard values.** The measured extension is the plan's extension days, and nothing is added to or taken off the extension length.

**The request the grant rests on.** This is the most recently received extension request on the case that is still awaiting a decision. Among extension requests received on the same day, the more recently received is the one recorded later by its recorded date and time, so a request re-filed on the day of the request it replaces is the one a grant rests on.

**When the figure is zero.**

- Where no extension request on the case is awaiting a decision, no extension is granted and the further extension days are zero.
- Where the supporting document of that request is neither a financing commitment nor a listing agreement, or carries no date, the request's evidence is insufficient, no extension is granted and the further extension days are zero.

**Other terms.** The case's as-is appraised value is the appraised value recorded on the case.

## Worked examples (hypothetical; an invented plan figure of 45 extension days)

| Request awaiting a decision | Measured extension | Raised to 30? | Further extension days |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes, with a dated listing agreement or financing commitment | 45 | no | 45 |
| yes, a document of another kind | not measured | not applicable | 0 |
| none | not measured | not applicable | 0 |
